explanation: Breadth-first traversal creates one new vertex for each reachable original vertex. The identity map preserves cycles and shared neighbors. Append every original edge, including duplicates, to the copied adjacency list without modifying the input graph.
timeComplexity: O(V + E) time over the reachable graph.
spaceComplexity: O(V) auxiliary space, plus O(V + E) for the returned graph.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
